description: Summary of a requested file download.

fileHandleId.description: The file handle id of a requested file.

associateObjectId.description: The ID of the object associated with the file

associateObjectType.description: The type of object associated with the file.

zipEntryName.description: The zip entry name used for this file.  This entry includes both the path and file name.  The value will only be set if the status is set to 'SUCCESS'

status.description: The download status of this file.
status.name: FileDownloadStatus

enum.name: SUCCESS
enum.description: The file was successfully included in the download.

enum.name: FAILURE
enum.description: The file could not be included in the download due to an error.

failureMessage.description: If the download status of this file is set to 'FAILURE', then this will be the failure message. Null for 'SUCCESS'.

failureCode.description: If the download status of this file is set to 'FAILURE', then this will be the failure code. Null for 'SUCCESS'.
failureCode.name: FileDownloadCode

enum.name: NOT_FOUND
enum.description: The requested file could not be found.

enum.name: UNAUTHORIZED
enum.description: The user does not have permission to download the file.

enum.name: DUPLICATE
enum.description: The file is a duplicate and was not included in the download.

enum.name: EXCEEDS_SIZE_LIMIT
enum.description: The file exceeds the allowed size limit for downloads.

enum.name: UNKNOWN_ERROR
enum.description: An unknown error occurred while processing the file download.
